summary: T1 item 9 (testbenches shipped): signoff/testbench-inventory.md lists every measured figure README.md and the characterization report currently quote, against the committed run it comes from, the bench that produced it, its cold-start command (sim/pvt/run-pvt-sweep.sh, sim/pvt/delay_probe.py, sim/iq/run-iq-sweep.sh, sim/startup/gen_requests.py, sim/pvt-postlayout/run-pex-pvt-sweep.sh, design/run-smoke-test.sh) and the PDK identity the run recorded. 'pass' asserts every claimed measurement has a committed, runnable bench. It discloses, and does not paper over, that most runs record only the PDK family gf180mcuC (no revision), the Iq run records only the install path in its manifest, and the smoke-test log records no PDK identity at all.
